definitions: A systematic error in research studies where the likelihood of a study being published or reported depends on the direction or strength of its findings.
The tendency for certain types of research outcomes (e.g., positive or statistically significant results) to be more frequently reported or published than others.
examples: The meta-analysis aimed to identify the presence of report bias.
Researchers are concerned about report bias in clinical trials.
Strategies were developed to mitigate report bias.
